name: Aidan Henry
life: “I still remember recognizing a relative's bread knife in a stranger's book.” People around Studio Boulevard know Aidan by a small Sunday habit. Aidan waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: I sat on the jury and recognized our family's kitchen in the scene. I should have said something before the vote.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a red windbreaker and a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. Aidan has a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones, with short copper curls. Aidan starts to lift a hand, then waits to be invited to speak during a conversation.
personality: Aidan listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To disclose the juror's family connection.
family: Bina Marsh is Aidan’s younger cousin. Aidan is free to hang up first. Bina makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The aquarium*, Bina says, “He kept telling me the filter was humming wrong.”
connections: Scout Gallagher. The juror's family recognition puts the runner-up in an awkward but legitimate position.
